2478584485680.text: Start! You are trapped in a dark, damp maze. Two doors lie ahead of you, one made of gold, and one made of silver.
2478584485680.left_option: Choose the gold door on the left
2478584485680.right_option: Choose the silver door on the right.

2478584485776.text: You go through the gold door on the left. Fresh air swiftly hits your nostrils. You are no longer trapped in the maze.

2478584485728.text: You go through the silver door on the right. A chill runs up your spine, as death swiftly arrives. Your body will be trapped in the maze for millennia.
